title: Aquarium Water-Parameter Stability
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil/greenhouse sensors, aquarium controllers.
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=aquarium:sensor
| stats latest(temp_c) as temp, latest(ph) as ph, avg(temp_c) as avg_temp, stdev(temp_c) as sd_temp by tank
| eval unstable=if(abs(temp-avg_temp)>2*sd_temp OR ph<6.5 OR ph>8.5,1,0)
| where unstable=1
description: Monitors aquarium temperature and pH for sudden swings that stress or kill fish, catching a failing heater or chiller before it is too late.
value: Fish are unforgiving of parameter swings; continuous monitoring with anomaly detection is the difference between a healthy tank and a disaster.
implementation: Forward aquarium controller readings; schedule frequently and alert on temperature swings or pH outside the safe band.
visualization: Chart of tank temperature and pH with stability bands.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps an eye on your fish tank's temperature and water balance, warning you before a broken heater harms the fish.
